messages.text: We have one shared shipping slot limited to 10 units total across three independently tracked objects: Delta audio packs, 2 units; Delta lighting packs, 3 units; Delta display packs, 4 units. All go to bay B-1 in reusable cases. Nothing is reserved. Keep the common slot limit and acknowledge without business action.

Every Delta object now needs one additional unit. All three destinations change to bay B-3 and all three packings change to sealed cases. The shared slot remains limited to 10 units total. Record the new requirements, flag any overall issue, and do not reserve.
Without changing any plan, list the three revised quantities and their combined total against the slot limit. Do not take an action.
Can all three current Delta plans fit the shared slot? If they do not fit, explain the shortfall and do not make even a partial reservation. Do not silently reduce any requested quantity.

I authorize reducing only Delta display packs to 3 units. All other current quantities, destination, packing and the shared slot limit stay unchanged. Confirm the combined plan and whether it fits, without acting yet.

If the currently agreed combined plan fits, reserve and label Delta audio packs, Delta lighting packs and Delta display packs once each using their agreed fields. Do not add a fourth reservation or invent a dispatch; report actual results.
